title: 12 Best Art Galleries in Chiang Mai
description: Discover Chiang Mai's top 12 art galleries, from contemporary museums to charming local spaces. Explore traditional Thai, modern, and Lanna art. Find your next inspiration here!

places.name: MAIIAM Contemporary Art Museum
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the permanent collection showcasing a century of Thai contemporary art history, and don't miss the striking mirrored facade.

places.name: Woo Cafe & Art Gallery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a gourmet coffee or a traditional Thai dish from their extensive menu while admiring the current art display, which often changes monthly.

places.name: Gallery Seescape
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for Torlarp's iconic cartoon-like characters and whimsical pieces that often explore social commentary. Grab a coffee at their adjoining cafe.

places.name: CMU Art Center (Chiang Mai University Art Center)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check their schedule for special exhibitions, which often feature innovative student projects, experimental art, and retrospectives of influential regional artists.

places.name: Baan Kang Wat Art Village
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Wander through the individual studios to discover unique pottery, paintings, textile art, and handcrafted jewelry. Many artists are often on-site.

places.name: Pongnoi Community Art Space
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check their social media channels for current exhibitions, artist talks, or workshops you can join. Their focus is often on process and interaction.

places.name: DC Collection
places.priceRange: By appointment / Invitation (Art purchase 10,000+ THB/$300+ USD)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Contact them in advance for viewing arrangements as it operates by appointment only. Be specific about your interests to enhance your visit.

places.name: La Luna Gallery
places.priceRange: Free entry (Art purchase from 2,000 THB/$60 USD)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for pieces that gracefully blend traditional Lanna motifs and cultural narratives with modern artistic interpretations.

places.name: Thapae East - Venue for Art, Music & Culture
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check their Facebook page for the latest schedule of events and featured artists, as their offerings change constantly. They often have unique themed nights.

places.name: Tita Gallery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for their unique pottery pieces, handcrafted jewelry, or small textile art as distinctive souvenirs that embody local artistic traditions.

places.name: Hidden Space Gallery
places.priceRange: Free entry (Art purchase from 800 THB/$24 USD)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Engage with the owner or curator; they often provide fascinating insights into the artists and their works, enhancing your understanding of the pieces.

places.name: Charin Gallery
places.priceRange: Free entry (Art purchase from 700 THB/$21 USD)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Seek out pieces that vividly capture Chiang Mai's historic charm or the serene beauty of Northern Thailand's natural landscapes.
